text.p: Shareholders of Polish construction company Elektromontaz Export SA have approved a 13 million zloty issue of 130 convertible bonds due January 1, 2000, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
The company said the bonds, with a par value of 100,000 zlotys each will be earmarked for a private placement for up to 300 investors and would carry an annual eight percent coupon.
Elektromontaz said one bond would be exchanged for 20,000 shares. It has earlier said its shareholders will vote on November 14 on issuing new shares to be taken up in exchange for the bonds.
Elektromontaz said it would be offering the bonds at or above par and the final issue price would be set through a tender.
